automationNotes: Doc: Open Studio via App Switcher, New Project, modal (Name, Description, Select Stack). Expand Advanced Settings; set Content Type Name and Content Type UID for the compositions content type (DOM: create-new-studio-project-m.html cs-accordion). UID uses {unique25} (lowercase, no spaces). Stack must match DEFAULT_STACK in .env.
